en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu nasr, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abd Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), regarding

a man who struck a man with a stick, so he did not raise the stick (stop) until he died. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be handed over to the guardian of the killed one, but he should not be left to enjoy the pleasure of it, but the sword should be allowed upon him’.
